Our team actively partners across the enterprise with key business units, including Accounting, Treasury, Legal, Supply Chain, and M&A Integration. We foster a flexible and supportive culture where team members share knowledge and tackle complex international tax challenges together. Drive key transfer pricing planning and compliance initiatives, including global documentation, advance pricing agreements (APAs), country-by-country reporting, and audit defense. Collaborate with cross-functional business teams to execute smooth transfer pricing integrations for newly acquired entities. Leverage and implement AI and automation solutions to optimize daily workflows and scale the team’s analytical capabilities. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of dedicated Transfer Pricing experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Oracle ERP systems, specifically

jobs.jd: The BR Analyst is responsible for accurate and timely processing of healthcare claims, identifying and resolving rejected or denied claims, and ensuring compliance with billing standards. This role involves monitoring billing queues, performing edits, analyzing rejection patterns, and collaborating with internal and external teams to optimize revenue cycle performance. The Analyst will play a key role in minimizing financial leakage, maintaining billing accuracy, and supporting operational efficiency. Essential Functions: In addition to working as prescribed in our Performance Factors specific responsibilities of this role include: Process claims in Customer Service (CS) queues, perform edits, and manage unbilled items to ensure timely submission. Review and analyze rejected or denied claims, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Maintain clear and accurate documentation of billing activities, including system notes and audit trails. Collaborate with internal teams and payers to resolve billing issues efficiently. jobs.skills: Invoice Processing, Accounting, GST, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Processing, Receivable, Assistance
jobs.jd: Role: Manage day-to-day accounting, maintain accurate financial records, coordinate payments and collections, and support financial reporting and statutory compliance across the companys business activities. Key Responsibilities Maintain books of accounts and record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Prepare and verify customer invoices, vendor bills, debit notes, and credit notes with supporting documents. Manage accounts payable and receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments. Reconcile bank statements, customer and vendor ledgers, and intercompany balances, where applicable. Maintain petty cash records and verify employee expense claims and reimbursements. Check purchase orders, delivery challans, goods receipt records, and invoices before processing payments. Coordinate with procurement, stores, sales, and operations teams to reconcile inventory transactions and resolve billing discrepancies. Prepare payroll inputs and support salary processing, deductions, and reimbursement calculations. Compile records and coordinate with the Chartered Accountant or tax consultant for GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory filings. Assist with monthly and annual closing, financial statements, audit schedules, and supporting documentation. Prepare periodic reports on cash flow, expenses, collections, payables, receivables, and budget variances. Maintain fixed asset records and assist with depreciation schedules. Ensure proper filing, confidentiality, and easy retrieval of financial records. Highlight payment discrepancies, overdue balances, and unusual transactions to management.

jobs.jd: Senior Analyst Secondary Loan Trade Servicing 4–7 Years Are you an experienced banking operations professional with strong expertise in secondary loan trade settlements, loan servicing and post-trade operations? We are looking for a skilled Senior Analyst to manage complex loan trade settlements, resolve escalations and ensure operational accuracy across loan servicing platforms. Responsibilities Manage the settlement and servicing of complex secondary loan trades, including distressed loans, partially funded positions, delayed-draw facilities and PIK positions. Resolve escalated settlement breaks, funding discrepancies and counterparty disputes through detailed root cause analysis. Coordinate with trading desks, middle office, finance teams and platform support teams to ensure seamless trade settlement and servicing. Requirements 4–7 years of experience in secondary loan trade settlement and servicing. Strong hands-on expertise in Loan IQ and ClearPar. In-depth knowledge of LSTA documentation

jobs.jd: US WEALTH MANAGEMENT ADVISOR American HNW Families | Private Wealth Analysis & Advisory We are seeking an experienced US Wealth Management Advisor with demonstrable expertise in wealth analysis, financial modelling, US taxation, and wealth management advisory support for American High-Net-Worth (HNW) families and their ventures. This role focuses on the financial affairs of affluent American families, encompassing personal balance sheets, cash flows, investments, trusts, legal entities, taxation, insurance, estate planning, and intergenerational wealth transfer. Occasional assignments involve family-owned or closely held businesses, particularly where liquidity events, acquisitions, divestitures, or succession decisions have implications for family wealth. You will translate validated financial information into rigorous analysis, sophisticated financial models, research-backed recommendations, and client-ready advisory materials. *Mandatory: Direct US Wealth Management Analysis and Advisory experience serving American HNW/UHNW clients. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Private Wealth Analysis & Financial Modelling Review and validate financial data relating to personal balance sheets, cash flows, investments, tax records, and financial planning systems. Independently develop, troubleshoot, and validate sophisticated financial models. Compare proposed wealth strategies against the status quo, stress-test assumptions, quantify outcomes, and document risks. Analyse family assets, liabilities, income, expenditure, investments, and interconnected financial structures. 2. Wealth Planning & Scenario Analysis Build multi-scenario models covering family cash flows, investment strategies, insurance, estate planning, and wealth transfer. Assess liquidity events, business exits, acquisitions

*Mandatory: Direct US Wealth Management Analysis and Advisory experience serving American HNW/UHNW clients.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 5 to 8 years of relevant professional experience.
Mandatory hands-on experience in US Wealth Management Analysis and Advisory for American HNW/UHNW individuals and families.
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Banking and Finance, Managerial Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
Experience using AI-assisted research and modelling tools, with rigorous output verification.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Progress towards CFA or CFP certification, or CPA exam eligibility.
Experience reviewing US personal, partnership, and corporate tax returns.
Experience modelling liquidity events, complex family cash flows, business transactions, or succession scenarios.
IDEAL CANDIDATE You are a technically strong wealth management professional with direct experience advising or supporting advisory engagements for American HNW/UHNW families.
APPLICATION PROCESS Submit your updated CV highlighting your direct US wealth management advisory experience, American HNW/UHNW client exposure, financial modelling expertise, US tax knowledge, and familiarity with wealth planning platforms.
Only candidates with demonstrable US Wealth Management experience will be considered.

jobs.jd: Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant with strong expertise in accounting, reconciliation, MIS reporting, and statutory compliances. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in balance sheet finalization, GST audits, and handling Income Taxrelated matters. Key Responsibilities: Perform accounts reconciliation (bank, vendor, customer, and inter-company). Prepare and finalize Balance Sheet and Trial Balance on a periodic basis. Generate Monthly MIS reports and provide financial analysis to management. Handle GST compliances, including returns, reconciliations, and coordination with GST department during audits. Respond to Income Tax notices, queries, and assessments. Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain accurate books of accounts and ensure compliance with statutory requirements. Coordinate with auditors, consultants, and internal teams for financial reviews and audits. Key Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of Accounting Principles and Finalization of Accounts Expertise in GST, Income Tax, and statutory compliances Proficiency in MIS reporting and financial analysis Hands-on experience with accounting software (Tally / ERP systems) Strong reconciliation and analytical skills Good communication and coordination skills Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CA (preferred) Experience Requirement: Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in accounting and taxation

Supporting stakeholder to ensure that business process goes smoothly with built in financial control in place Prepare the presentations, reports and fulfil any other type of requirement from time to time for the management Key Accountabilities Total Delivered Cost : Monthly preparation SCC G&A and Logistic analysis and timely reporting to the HO and SCC Head. jobs.jd: Purpose of the role The Project Manager will take end-to-end ownership of assigned industrial EPC and air pollution control projects from order handover through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, dispatch, erection, commissioning, commercial closure and final handover. The position is accountable for schedule, cost, quality, contractual compliance, customer communication and coordination across all internal and external stakeholders. Key responsibilities Act as the single-point owner for assigned domestic and international projects, normally valued at INR 10 crore to INR 50 crore or above. Review the contract, technical scope, commercial terms, exclusions, milestones, liquidated damages, bank guarantees, payment terms and project risks at order handover. Prepare and maintain the baseline schedule, detailed activity plan, cash-flow and billing plan, procurement plan, manufacturing plan and recovery schedule whenever delays arise. Coordinate drawings and approvals, procurement, vendor documentation, manufacturing, fabrication, inspection, packing, dispatch, erection, commissioning and performance testing. Conduct structured weekly project reviews and maintain action, risk, drawing, procurement, manufacturing, dispatch, site, billing and change-order trackers. Identify critical-path delays, assign owners and due dates, escalate unresolved constraints and drive practical corrective action across departments. Manage client meetings and correspondence, including progress reporting, delay notifications, extension-of-time requests, scope changes, variation orders and claim-support documentation. Monitor project budget versus actual cost and control avoidable rework, expediting, freight, site and delay costs. Ensure timely submission, certification and recovery of invoices

jobs.jd: The Dialer & WFM Analyst owns the full workforce and dialer lifecycle for a US outbound sales operation from forecasting and scheduling to real-time intraday management, end-to-end dialer administration, DID health, and lead/attempt quality. This is a data-driven, ownership-heavy role: the analyst is expected to deliver root-cause analysis and action plans, not just reports, while ensuring every dialing activity stays within US compliance requirements (TCPA/DNC). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. FORECASTING & CAPACITY PLANNING Prepare daily/weekly/monthly outbound call volume forecasts Forecast attempts using lead volume, source, historical connect rate, attempts/number & conversion Calculate required vs. available HC; factor in shrinkage, attrition, leave & training Flag under/overstaffing risk; size HC for new campaigns Maintain Forecast vs. Actual and improve accuracy continuously 2. SCHEDULING Build schedules aligned to forecasted calling demand Optimize shifts, breaks, lunches & offline activity Align staffing to US time zones and peak calling windows Build campaign-wise and interval-wise staffing plans Rebalance schedules against live campaign performance 3. RTA / INTRADAY MANAGEMENT Real-time ownership not just an adherence report. Monitor login/logout, scheduled vs. actual hours, break/AUX, idle time, absenteeism, late login/early logout Track actual workload vs. forecast through the day; flag gaps immediately Recommend agent movement across campaigns; control break timing in peaks Escalate critical issues; maintain an intraday action log 4. MIS & MANAGEMENT REPORTING Owns the complete WFM/MIS reporting framework. Daily: Scheduled/Login/Absent/Productive/Available HC, Attempts, Connects, Connect & Conversion rate, AHT, Occupancy, Utilization, Adherence, Campaign/Lead/Dia

This is a processing role with direct accountability for data integrity, deadlines, state-wise compliance templates and audit-ready records. Key Responsibilities: Benefits Administration: Enrollment and Eligibility Enrollment : Process new hire enrollments, qualifying life events, open enrollment elections and terminations across medical, dental, vision, life, disability and voluntary plans. Eligibility : Track eligibility and waiting periods, resolve eligibility disputes and enrollment discrepancies, and keep plan rules documented by state and employee class. COBRA : Initiate and track COBRA notices and continuation coverage on terminations and reductions in hours. Employee Support : Manage and triage the benefits inbox, answer employee and manager questions, and close out requests within agreed turnaround times Carrier, EDI and Vendor Management EDI Feeds: Monitor carrier EDI feeds (UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, The Hartford and others), work error and discrepancy reports, and confirm elections and terminations land correctly with each carrier. Invoice Reconciliation: Reconcile monthly carrier invoices against payroll deductions and enrollment records, flag variances, and raise credits and corrections with carriers and the broker. Vendor Tracker: Maintain the shared vendor request tracker (including WEX account items) with daily status updates, owners, dependencies and turnaround times for the client's accounting and HR tea
